issue.title: [1.15 Hotfix] Preserve both yearly-pulse effects through additive on_action dispatch
issue.body:
## Delivery — 2026-11-09

**IMPLEMENTED_READY_FOR_RUNTIME_VALIDATION. Project 1 status: In review, changed and verified in the authenticated maintainer session. Issue remains open pending engine/human acceptance.**

The yearly hook no longer declares two competing effect blocks. Only `common/on_actions/phase1_japan_tenpo_on_actions.txt` changes: its original Japanese effect is moved intact to `aor1776_phase1_japan_yearly_pulse`, called through an additive `on_actions` contribution to `on_yearly_pulse`. This follows the installed Victoria 3 **1.15.0** on_action contract. The main hook file and Manila earthquake branch are byte-identical.

All Japanese dates, variables, laws, DLC guard, scope and six event calls remain unchanged. This corrects a documented script incompatibility; it does not claim reproduced engine execution order or a last-provider-wins observation.

### Validation and evidence
- Candidate and installed version: **15/15 static checks**.
- **Four negative controls** detect the original conflict, broken child reference, changed Japanese date and modified main file; **one positive control** accepts valid additive declarations.
- Effective inventory: **321 → 322** on_actions, **1,132 → 1,133** list/fallback references; exactly one new resolved child link.
- Duplicate effect/trigger conflicts: **1 → 0**; zero parse errors in the inventoried inputs.
- Six pre-existing missing targets remain explicitly reported: `marx_events.3`, `japan_events.32–35` and `on_memento_mori`. They are outside this correction and are not suppressed or automatically reactivated.
- Source protection: **2,968** pre-existing runtime files captured; only the authorized Japanese file differs, exactly as the candidate. No runtime file added. **7/7** protection checks pass, including current audit inputs, native contract, Git index and HEAD.
- No engine/human validation, Git write, native modification, branch operation, merge or publication.

Evidence: `docs/reports/compatibility/V1_15_ISSUE45_YEARLY_DISPATCH_2026_11_09/` — report, bounded runtime protocol, before/candidate files, patch, inventories, validation, controls, source protection, installation receipt and final board screenshot. Validator: `tools/compatibility/issue45_yearly_dispatch_audit.py`.

### Board synchronization
Actual Project columns for **#42, #43 and #44** were reconciled to **In review** in this session; **#45** was reserved In progress before implementation and moved to **In review** after verification. Final board screenshot shows **In review 5/5** (#23, #42, #43, #44, #45). No issue was closed or marked Done.

- [x] Document provider conflict and native append contract.
- [x] Install one bounded file correction, preserving both effects.
- [x] Candidate/live checks, controls, list inventory and source protection.
- [x] Synchronize and verify Project status.
- [ ] Engine/human acceptance using `RUNTIME_PROTOCOL.md`.

<details>
<summary>Original assignment retained</summary>

## Current assignment — Codex, 2026-11-09

**Claimed at the maintainer's request to take the next mission and keep the board current. Requested Project status: In progress.**

Canonical `common/on_actions/_on_actions.md` allows additive on_action definitions but forbids multiple effect blocks on the same named hook. The effective mod has two `effect` blocks for `on_yearly_pulse`: the existing Manila earthquake branch in `00_code_on_actions.txt` and the Japan progression branch in `phase1_japan_tenpo_on_actions.txt`.

### Bounded correction
- Preserve the main hook and Manila file completely.
- Move the existing Japanese effect body, unchanged, into one uniquely named child on_action.
- Make the Japanese contribution to `on_yearly_pulse` an additive `on_actions = { child }` dispatcher, following the installed native documentation.
- Preserve all Japanese date windows, variables, laws, DLC guard, six event calls and root/country scope.
- Verify additive provider semantics, exact body preservation, no new missing reference, controls and source/index/native protections.

The supporting list audit also records six pre-existing missing targets (five events and `on_memento_mori`). These are outside this one-file conflict fix and must remain visible; no historical event or obsolete mortality handler is silently reactivated.

- [ ] Document provider conflict and native append contract.
- [ ] Install one bounded file correction, preserving both effects.
- [ ] Candidate/live checks, controls, list inventory and source protection.
- [ ] Engine/human acceptance; no claimed runtime order or reproduced last-provider-wins behavior.

Related workstream #25. No #39 journal edits, law/technology/history/map/economy rewrite, Git write, native modification, branch operation, merge or publication. Local evidence will use a task-specific `V1_15_ISSUE<number>_YEARLY_DISPATCH_2026_11_09/` directory.

</details>
